fields.web: boolean, optional, default false — when true the backend performs one Tavily search before the LLM call (AC-86)

fields.event: literal 'sources' — emitted at most once, BEFORE any token event, only when the request had web=true
fields.sources: array of {n: integer 1-based, title, url}; empty on search failure
fields.notice: string, present only on search failure: 'web search unavailable' (AC-89)

fields.title: string
fields.messages: array of HistoryEntry (role: "user"|"assistant", content, ts, model, optional sources: array of SourceLink — absent, never empty-list, when the message had no web sources)

fields.quarantined: boolean — true while a quarantined (unreadable) snapshot file sits beside the data file

fields.web_configured: boolean — true iff TAVILY_API_KEY is set (AC-90)

externals.notes: Backend reads models[].key and models[].loaded_instances (non-empty = loaded). The UI-test mock serves this shape.

externals.probe: curl -sS -N -X POST http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"qwen/qwen3.6-27b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"/no_think Say hi in three words"}],"stream":true}'
externals.notes: OpenAI chunk shape. Captured reality (2026-07-08): thinking arrives INLINE as <think>...</think> inside delta.content — this LM Studio config emits no reasoning_content. Think text therefore reaches the frontend through SSE 'token' events; the frontend must render it via the think toggle AND strip it from stored/POSTed history. The 'think' SSE event path (reasoning_content) remains contractually valid for configs that parse reasoning.

externals.probe: curl -sS https://api.tavily.com/search -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAVILY_API_KEY" -d '{"query":"latest stable Python version July 2026","max_results":4}'
externals.notes: Captured 2026-07-17 against the live API. Backend reads top-level results[] only: url, title, content (extracted page prose — quality varies by page, hence the per-source char cap). score/raw_content/answer/images are present in the shape but unread. Key travels as Authorization: Bearer; TAVILY_ENDPOINT env overrides the URL so the sandboxed suite binds a loopback stub.
